answer: One defense is a dye-lot lantern ledger. Each seat gets a watch post on a named mesa and a monthly bottle of lantern oil tinted with a unique jade pigment, sealed and lot-numbered. A rim photometer logs the burn curve, so a claim lacking the right spectrum, burn rate, or one flame is void. Sybils cannot share a post: overlapping curves from two claims cancel both, and bottles cannot be refilled. Fielding a thousand puppets means buying a thousand sealed lots, building a thousand chimneys, and paying keepers to trim wicks nightly, recurring cost per identity, all tracing to one buyer.
